one_genuine_exception_found.what: A real 3-fold expanding-window walk-forward: train on an earlier span, pick the best floor by TRAIN total_r among {2.0, 1.75, 1.5, 1.25, 1.0}, then measure that SAME floor on the following, never-seen year.
one_genuine_exception_found.result: The walk-forward CONTRADICTED the in-sample sweep's apparent winner (R:R=1.0): on the most recent, most decision-relevant fold, R:R=1.0 collapsed out-of-sample (+8.48R/48.6% WR) while the current production default R:R=2.0 held up better on the identical test window (+13.89R/64.3% WR). Verdict: keep min_risk_reward=2.0 unchanged -- see optimization_history.csv OPT-4.
one_genuine_exception_found.caveat: This split validates min_risk_reward on the OLDER single-pair EURUSD-only, 3-feeder-model (1AM+5AM+9AM) population, not the final 3-pair (EURUSD/USDCAD/AUDUSD), 2-feeder-model (1AM+9AM, 5AM dropped) production recipe this audit's trades.csv/execution_events.csv cover. It was never re-run against the current recipe.
